# Vertical Infinity Pvt. Ltd.

> AI-enabled digital agency based in Mumbai, India, operating since 2003 (formerly Zxis). We help SaaS, Education, Media & Publishing and eCommerce organisations build high-performing digital platforms, connect complex systems and scale with confidence.

- Google Business Profile rating: 4.9 / 5

## What we do

- Product Development: end-to-end web, mobile and SaaS product engineering — discovery → design → build → launch → scale, sized to the client's budget, with full IP ownership and post-launch support.
- Workflow Automation: mapping and automating manual business processes (Map → Design → Connect → Monitor).
- Legacy Modernization: assess → stabilise → rebuild → scale for ageing platforms, reducing risk while adding capability.
- AI & Automation: practical AI assistants, agents and automations integrated into existing business systems.
- Experience Design: UX research, UI design and design systems for conversion and usability.
- Digital Commerce: storefronts, catalog/ERP integrations and checkout optimisation.
- Performance Services: speed, Core Web Vitals, SEO and reliability engineering.
- Managed Support: ongoing maintenance, monitoring and enhancement retainers.
- Also: website development, custom applications, mini apps, experimental marketing, domain/hosting/email services.
